entities.summary: Pavel Vasilyevich Sergeyev was a Soviet Russian pharmacologist, Doctor of Medical Sciences, Professor, Academician of the Russian Academy of Medical Sciences (1991) and Correspondent Member of the USSR Academy of Medical Sciences (1986). Honored Scientist of the Russian Federation (1996), and Laureate of the State Prize of the Russian Federation in the field of science and technology for the year 1997.
